Hey Survivors!

The first two weeks of the fresh Survival wipe are now behind us, and we’ve made and released a host of updates—especially around loot and vehicle adjustments.

Loot: General adjustments have been made, with notable differences between Official and Private servers.
Vehicles: Spawn count increased from 22 to 63, and the max number of spawned vehicles raised from 12 to 20.

The camping backpack spawn (intended for beta testers) has been removed and replaced with the Alice backpack.Helicopter Crash Loot:

Gasoline: Added to civilian and vehicle trunk loot tables.Zombies: Night Zombie spawn chance reduced from 100% to 25%.

Removed the “Empty Slot” item. This was supposed to represent currency, which isn’t supported by the current airdrop system.XP Rewards: Increased XP gained from killing night zombies.
Note: Some of these changes were server-side and have already been rolled out, as noted in the devupdates channel on our Discord.

notes.title: Survival Mode Update: Wipe & New Beginnings!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4326122/dd5ae79a6605d90ffded5fc8342df82ec9cfbb43.jpg

Hello Survivors,

We’re excited to announce the upcoming Survival Mode Wipe! This fresh start will bring everyone back to square one, leveling the playing field and offering all players a renewed challenge. Along with the wipe, we’re introducing several key changes to enhance gameplay and keep things exciting.

🌟 What's Changing in Survival Mode? 
The wipe is just the beginning! We’ve made updates across various aspects of Survival Mode to improve balance, and refine the experience. Here’s a preview of what you can look forward to:


Original Colorado map
Night zombies, which are more dangerous
Limited access to SuperZombies
Improved loot system: each town now offers specific loot based on what you're searching for
Disable skins option
Crafting list reset; we will add more recipes based on player feedback
Contracts removed; we're planning to bring back direct missions

*These aren't all changes, just the most important ones.

Improved Loot System
This is an important update, so let me explain it in detail. Essentially, loot spawns are now determined by the number of players on the server. The more players there are, the more loot will spawn.
This change affects both Official and Private servers.

Private Server Loot
One of the most frequently asked questions is about loot balancing on private servers. Private servers have a loot debuff compared to Official servers, meaning that 50 players on a private server won’t see the same amount of loot as 50 players on an Official server. However, renting a private server allows you to farm in peace and explore the world without the risk of being attacked by others.

Missions
I’d like to move away from the contracts idea, as it doesn’t really fit a survival game.
But let me explain why we introduced contracts in the first place. Contracts are linked to your account, whereas missions you accept and complete on the map are character-based. This means that map missions can only be started and finished by a single character, while contracts can be started and completed by any character within a game mode.
At the moment, there aren’t many missions available. Completing them would have taken more time, so I’ll be preparing an update specifically for missions in the near future.


We hope these updates will create a more dynamic and engaging experience, and we’re excited to see how you adapt to the changes!

Thank you for being part of this adventure. Let’s dive into Survival Mode’s fresh start together!

- Team Fredaikis

notes.title: Survival Reset: Rise from the Ashes
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4326122/ca7c7fb2689cff6713ae83401454ad6cae53469f.jpg
Hello Survivors!

We are here to bring you some exciting news!
We've made our decision on the date for the Survival Reboot and its upcoming wipe!

The official date for the wipe and server reopening is November 9th, 2024! This will happen right after our Halloween event ends!

When the time comes, the servers will go down briefly for a quick patch. During this time, we will also perform the wipe on SURVIVAL to prepare it for release right after!

Afterward, everything in Survival will be wiped. This includes characters, clans, territories, and more. However, all cosmetic items and options you have already acquired will remain intact.

Now, let’s go over some details in more depth!

Are we wiping every game mode?
No. None of the other game modes will be affected; this wipe will only impact Survival.

Is anything from my account going to be lost?
Only your SURVIVAL characters and SURVIVAL GI will be wiped. Everything account-based will remain untouched.

Will we get anything back from the wiped items?
Last time we attempted item returns, it caused more harm than good. This time, there will be no return of any items to Survival.

What about my cosmetic items and active cosmetics?
Those are part of your account; they are ACCOUNT ITEMS/ASSETS. This means they will not be wiped.
Your skins, character models, sprays, and spawn protections—your account assets—will remain.
Additionally, account items like skin boxes and skin recipes will not be removed.

How long will the first 'season' last?
There is no ETA for this as it’s the first 'season', and we need to analyze data before making a final decision.

With that in mind, expect our patch on 09/11/2024 to take a bit longer. If you have any questions or want to join the discussion, please join us on Discord.

For the full announcement on upcoming Survival changes, check out our Official Announcement.
If you need assistance with any issues, please open a support ticket.

notes.title: Survival Changes for Upcoming Wipe
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4326122/20d89d2ccfee236f173c83fa1edef89702f3ca09.png

Infestation: The New Beginning

As most of you know, we have been preparing significant changes for our game, specifically the Survival Game Mode. However, in this case, instead of innovating, we will be returning to the basics—what has worked in the past and what the community has been clamoring for!
 
Why is Survival being rebooted?
After several attempts at introducing new elements to Survival, your feedback has shown us what should remain unchanged in order to preserve the feeling we had when we played The War Z and Survivor Stories back in the day, and what can be kept from the recent changes. With that in mind, we have decided to recreate the game as it was—ambiance, loot rarity, mechanics, etc.—while retaining only the well-known and unquestionable improvements we've made since then. This, however, will be our starting point.

Post changes to it
From that point on, any changes we decide to make will be based solely on suggestions and polls from active Survival players. These polls will not lead to direct or immediate changes. One key consideration is that a 51% approval in polls will not be considered a sufficient majority. We need to assess whom the changes will affect and how they will impact those people. Therefore, we will require a larger margin for approval. We also aim to structure the polls in a straightforward manner, including an option like 'doesn't matter to me' to minimize the potential for larger groups to manipulate the results.

The goal of the new Survival mode is to ensure FUN for EVERYONE. Changes that could negatively impact a significant portion of the community, or that are controversial and divisive, may be rejected. 

Initial Plans for Survival
Our initial plans are based on the feedback we've received so far from the community, who are eager to experience a true Survival mode, reminiscent of what Infestation/The War Z once was.

Seasons
We will structure the game mode into seasons, following a classic seasonal system with wipes occurring at set intervals to keep the game fresh and the community engaged. Our initial plan is for seasons to last 6 to 9 months, but we need to assess whether that works for most players. To determine the ideal season length, we will run the first season without a fixed end date. This will allow us to observe how far players progress into the endgame and how long it takes before they no longer have anything left to do.

Maps
We will have only ONE map available at all times, and the same map will be used across both Official and Private Servers. There may be maps for specific TEMPORARY events with different rules, etc. Missions will also be available throughout the season, though at the beginning, they will be more limited. There will be fewer missions initially, as they can greatly impact player progression. To achieve the right balance, we need to observe how the game mode feels without excessive 'boosts' to progression and the economy.

Skins
Skins are a very controversial aspect of Survival. There are a few things we need to address, but we believe we’ve found a fair balance.

First, let’s talk about clan skins. Clans with existing clan skins can request to have them re-added to the new Survival mode. This can only be done by the current clan leader, who must have a character and clan created in the Game Mode.

Second, and most importantly: Skins are optional! While everyone knows you can choose not to use skins, that doesn’t stop others from using them. With that in mind, we’ve introduced a new system that allows you to disable all item skins in your game.

So, even if a player has a skin equipped, you won’t see it if you’ve enabled this option. However, if you enable the option and have a skin equipped yourself, even though you won’t see the skin, others who haven’t enabled this option will still be able to see it.

Loot
Another major change to the game mode will be the loot system. We’re going back to basics, removing many of the new gun additions (which we may reintroduce gradually later). The goal is to recreate the loot system as it was in the past, both in terms of rarity and placement, along with the quirky randomness we all remember. Who doesn’t recall finding a Mauser SP66 in a small-town supermarket?

However, on both Official and Private Servers, we’ve added a new system where the more players are connected to the server, the more loot will spawn. This system was introduced to ensure Private Servers don’t provide excessive advantages over Official Servers, while still making Private Servers appealing since you have the entire server to yourself. 

Zombies
Zombies are going back to basics, with Super Zombies being the only 'supers' available. They will no longer spawn 24/7 as they do now, but will only appear at certain times of the day (in-game time).

Additionally, we’ve introduced zombie variations during nighttime, along with an increased number of zombies. These nighttime zombies will also grant players more EXP and XP.

General Changes
In addition to the option to disable skins, we are also removing the option to disable shadows. With today’s hardware, shadows have minimal impact on performance, and the only reason to disable them is to make the game easier. We're going against that, as we want to maintain the element of surprise and encourage furtive, stealthy gameplay, especially in cities.

Another small but important change we've made is that, even if you have physics disabled, dropped items will no longer float and obstruct players' view.

Additionally, the overgrowth on buildings has been fixed and redone in certain areas to prevent abusive behavior.

Official Dates and Times

We will provide more details, including dates, times, and in-depth information, soon, so stay tuned!

Join our discussion on our discord server CLICK HERE

notes.title: Oceania Servers UPDATE
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4326122/10c97c6062c1f4424255eca86c0a7a7b7fca47d5.jpg

Oceania Servers will be taken down. 

Dear players,
Due to the recent and upcoming increase in electricity prices for our provider, the prices for the servers have also been raised substantially in the last few months and will continue on the rise on the upcoming months. 
Since our contract renewal is coming up soon, we have made the decision to shut down our servers there for the foreseeable future as a way to prevent it from forcing us to also raise our prices in that specific region on October 1st, 2023. 
That, combined with the low demand of private servers in the region and the low amount of players at peak times in that region, we thought this would be the best course of action. 

For everyone who currently has a server in our Oceania server, you can request a move to any other region by submitting a ticket at http://support.playnewz.com/ 

Thank you for understanding

BOX HUNTING EVENT

Hello Survivors,

This weekend we will be doing a very different and special event!
We will be placing lockboxes with a password around servers in all regions with some cosmetic items for you to find!
Now here's the catch: They will be placed in Arcade Official Servers. Which means, not only do you have to find them, but you will need to get out ALIVE. 
No special rules apply to this event - If you find it, put in the password and get out with it, it's yours. 
If someone else finds it and you kill them, their loot is ALL yours!

Start: 05.05.2023, 1:00 PM CEST
End: 08.05.2023, 1:00 PM CEST

Each locker will have these skinboxes and will NOT be replenished. So you might find it, put in the password and they'll be empty!

5 Lockboxes will be placed in one server per region in Arcade.

They are placed in all Colorado 001 Servers, for each region.

In each of the servers, they will be placed in the same 5 locations, BUT NOT THE SAME SPOTS!

So for example, and I will use this an example as this will not be one of the locations (this is your first hint, wink wink): There is a box that is in Clearview, which could the direct hint. Now, they will all be placed inside the Police Station. BUT they won't be placed in the same exact room every time. One could be in the cell, the other in the office, the other right outside by the police cars.

Our hints may be extremely direct - with the name of the city/town OR they can have just an indication, a pun, a reference to the area, so just read carefully!

So here we go... The HINTS for each lockboxes are the following: 

#1 - Campos - Yes, that's the only hint. ANYWHERE in the whole city!
#2 - It seems as if it was a safezone before, but it's not anymore. Keep driving south;
#3 - Boulder City - Also anywhere in the whole city;
#4 - A vintage PVP spot that had a map of its own made;
#5 - There was a huge fire here;

And the password for the lockers is: 23fentotsi0a2in

Happy Hunting!

notes.title: Patch 5.7 - Easter Content
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/c2d002cb8c8aab8bcd187c412f019356648fd77a.jpg

Hello everyone,
We are happy to announce a new patch in the game!
This new patch has some important fixes, especially when it comes to quality of life. That includes fixes to how the Mission System reads and computes items required for them, improvements on vehicle issues, and some new features like a different hitmarker on an enemy with Spawn Protection and First-Person crosshair!

GENERAL CHANGES
GENERAL FIXES & CHANGES:
Picking up mission items in stacks should now properly count. 
Grabbing required items from your stash or item boxes will also progress properly for the missions. Fixed a bug where you could get kicked after getting off a vehicle.
Fixed an issue with the Auto Skin system that happened in Battle Royale when picking up a K. Style Helmet during the round or the Warmup lobby. 
Fixed the model of the Competitive v2 skinbox.
Fixed some map errors on the Tutorial map.
Fixed some players spawn in Caliwood and Colorado on Arcade.
Added a new indicator if you shoot an enemy that has spawn protection. You will get now a light-blue hitmarker.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/3666eb0c08dd12238ab13c715aac55d787353d8c.png
Added an option to enable your crosshair in First Person. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/007f4a52393d2fd9b9af053984e638f43a3d0390.png

 
Easter 2022 Event

During Easter month (12.04.2022 - 25.04.2022) we will be holding special events for short periods. 
Those events include and are not limited to:

 Double XP/currency/reputation
 Twitch Stream Events
 Special Weekend Events 
 and more!

We will also release a new set of Easter-themed missions and activities. 

 Missions exclusive to PvP.
 Missions on both game modes
 Themed rewards in Battle Royale and Competitive.
 New missions with new items.
 A new backpack with some skin variations to celebrate Easter
 And more!

For more information on the event missions, click HERE!

More information about the event will come soon in a separate announcement.

notes.title: Patch 5.6
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/f23692f1f931f53e57664b66b85a22c865b9447d.jpg

Hello everyone,
We are bringing a small patch to address a few issues and some fixes for you. Half of the changes came live last week when we had the urgent hotfix.


GENERAL CHANGES
GENERAL FIXES & CHANGES:
Redesigned the Airport Tower. As whatever was done, players found a way to abuse it. We have now completely removed the middle of it, so it's open!
Adjusted the Account/Season XP gained in some unbalanced contracts.
Fixed the contract Weekend Contract 3 where zombie kills did not properly count. 
Fixed a crash that happened while moving and the item name was rotating in the inventory (when you hover over the item and the text is too long). 
Fixed a bug in the animation that gave players an unfair advantage when throwing grenades and being stuck on that animation.
Renamed the Airdrop Caller GD to Airdrop Caller Normal, since it can also be purchased with other game mode currencies.
Fixed the Airdrop Caller Normal in your inventory when you received one in both game modes at the same time. That could cause desyncs. 
Adjusted the physics of the garage building in all maps and game modes.
Added a legacy icon on items or contracts which are from the previous events. This icon means these contracts might not work anymore since the event is over.
Improved the mission system overview - It now shows in proper order.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/2d98b497c8a3aa801b81fd390eff45dc4a2b35de.png

SURVIVAL
FIXES & ADDITIONS:
Fixed some loot crates that had no loot inside.
Added some areas around the hangers to give players the ability to use the areas better. 
Added more openings on the south side of the Airport to give players a better way to enter the fight. 
Added more cover around the airport to give players a way to push in a safer matter. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/927753d4c9f9860dfbdbdc4fbcca04cce2cc27c4.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/812218d998125851100151883d18ef2bf7cfc385.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/6d33986ea083427334af89080ca48231b4189c23.png
Decreased the cooldown of the wood shield barricades.
Added a new crafting recipe. You can now craft rope out of cloth.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/53d25cbe60e897cc98e44051c830a56b97bb5d92.png
Rank 1 and Rank 2-10 Skins for the leaderboards should be now working in Survival and Competitive.


ARCADE
FIXES & ADDITIONS:
Fixed some spawns around Colorado that would make players spawn inside objects. 
Removed some undesired objects left over from the Xmas event.
Changed the Trading Lounge to the Summer version.
The Arena map is now daytime only. 
 Valentine contract exchange is be possible again on the Trading Lounge.


BATTLE ROYALE
FIXES & ADDITIONS:
Fixed a bug where you would keep buffs after ending a match and starting a new one.
We are working on contracts for Battle royale right now. More information will come soon.


COMMUNITY POLL
MOTO HELMET:
As we mentioned on the last patch, we ran a poll about the Moto Helmet becoming an item on its own. 
Whoever had a recipe for the regular Moto Helmet, received 1.000.000 GD for each recipe.

notes.title: Season Pass 10 available!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/6be304a10d516f3d3252e1071f04132fd0fc4b58.jpg

Hey Survivors!

Now it's time. We are going to release our newest Season Pass 10. This Season Pass also brings a lot of changes which are listed below.

Start
01.03.2022, 12:00 PM CET

Changes

A unique skin set is going to be available in this Season Pass called Crystal as you can see at the top image.
You are able to get XP for the Season Pass from contracts on top of the general mission complete XP. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/1684800421600da9266dd93c3472f9e7faff620a.png
We started adding more items to the reward list such as weapons, usable items, and more!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/b9a876889a0480b7685fe53d04fb55eff22cc10b.png
Currency rewards of Battle Royale, Competitive, and Survival has been increased by 100% which means double.
New kinds of contracts will get added to the contract boxes in Arcade and Survival.
The green color around means it's fully PVE and the blue ones are PVE/PVP. This way we will bring PVP more into contracts aka people that are only PVP will have a chance to grind the Season Pass. 
Some of the contracts also have a weapon type restriction, which is visible in the icon or inside the description.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/c1bc7a0dc8f1e4165d7fdd650efecd85cf36ee5c.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/fd0773c2303c865eae8909d7b8a9579af9a15b45.png
We called them weekend/week contracts because our plan is to release every week new ones in the future. For now, we will release like 20 on the Season Pass release date. Keep in mind, they will get added to the contract boxes in each game mode.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/0fa30c2b10c2ace8e01a0fc729c61e6ea45f6038.png



Do you have feedback about the latest changes? Let us know inside our feedback section on discord. We will try to improve the Season Pass more and more until every type of player, PVE or PVP, is happy.

We hope you like the latest changes and enjoy the grind!

Fredaikis Team

notes.title: Patch 5.5
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36854961/63eed7a4768bdf8366d76ba1b8c99294fac49181.jpg

Hello everyone,
We are bringing another patch for you guys that will bring content for the next global event!
We are also making major corrections to the AI and Quality of Life towards them, along with engine corrections to improve overall performance for both game client and server. These will also allow us more leeway to create new features.
And we are adding a handy visual update to show you when you receive EXP and Season Pass XP.

GENERAL CHANGES
GENERAL FIXES & CHANGES:

Fixed an issue with Ridgeway Airport walls and its physics where people were able to abuse them.
Fixed issues in the Polish localization of the game. 
Fixed an issue with Halloween contracts not giving the intended amount of rewards.
Fixed a building model in Campos City and other towns around Colorado. 
Fixed the LOD of the Airport Towers. It now should render properly. 
Fixed an issue that caused a Disconnect during the Warmup in Competitive.
Changed one Official Server to PvE (Both Arcade and Survival) due to poll results. 

COSMETICS
NEW:
Added a completely new and reworked Battle Royale skinset.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/7b3d612d1d0f287c43bfa15b81e5ddbc895b482e.png

FIXES AND CHANGES:

Fixed the Store Icon for the G36 Battle Royale Skin
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/fd31e20f04e2c0793b5d70991f5554e510f5abef.png
Reworked the SWAT Armor. There were some cases of performance problems with it for some players.
Improved the icons for the Crossbow.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/e3a95e3d6a07abed44ba286bed76a5e50c0bcf80.jpg
Reworked the icons for the B92 and all of its skins. 
Reworked the Hunter Backpack. It should now fit the character model better.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/3b6781e12c8613896b92a2a8158af0e8bbdaf52d.jpg
Improved the Heavy Armor Cupido model.
Improved the Heavy Armor Solari model.
Improved the Heavy Armor Unicorn model.

SURVIVAL
FIXES:

We made changes and moved around the walls around Ridgeway Airport (Colorado) to prevent glitching.
Fixed a bug where Bus Stops wouldn't work properly in Beginner Servers. 

ARCADE
FIXES:

Fixed some player spawns in Colorado that could cause players to spawn inside objects.
Removed all the Christmas Event content from the Trading Lounge.

BATTLE ROYALE
FIXES:

Fixed a bug that could cause the kill count to be reset when revived. 
Fixed a visual bug that an item could persist (only visually) from the Warmup to the Match. 

COMMUNITY POLL
MOTO HELMET:

We ran an in-game poll about making the Moto Helmet an item on its own. Right now it's a skin for the K. Style Helmet which doesn't make a lot of sense. The stats are going to be the same and the change is planned for Patch 5.6.

notes.title: Patch 5.3
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/dadd53af98e76bbe0eb7eac1eaaf3412b97d6fe5.jpg

Hello Survivors!
On this patch we are bringing a few quality of life changes that have been both suggested and requested for a while and also some fixes for some smaller errors/bugs in the game. 

GENERAL CHANGES
CLAN MANAGEMENT UPDATE
With this update, we are introducing a rework for the clan section. It is a complete overhaul that will see more options on your clan. 
This has been asked for a while and though we wanted to work on this earlier, we had more pressing priorities. 
Clan creation was one of the first features brought under the original developer team in The War Z, but it was lackluster. We have put off doing this complete rework for some time as we didn't feel it was that urgent as, though it was too "plain", it worked for its purpose. 
However, we decided recently to start working on QOL changes such as this to make it even easier to understand for all players, new and old. 

Here are some of the changes made to it:
To access the new Clan Menu, you can find it here:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/a87ae828b0b02ce309cc9a99fcfe0df1cad15e08.jpg

On this menu, you can see all clans and their public information. 
You can also use the sort tabs to better navigate
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/ca7c8b59900e783350b126d379be77a63530d53c.jpg

Clicking on a clan will show you all the public information on the clan, as such
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/80adf919e81a34e6d4e28361aca97e3df5c1a5bc.jpg

Clicking on your clan on the top left will bring up a slightly different menu, with all the known functions you already had in addition to the Customize button:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/1332e749eeb40ad61230b46d2065590d48900292.jpg

On the Customization menu, you will be able to edit your clan icon, name, description and tag color.
With the clan tag color, you can also pick any RGB color from the menu that pops up:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/7b388f8d949da030c70d7f0fa0ad091c1f98561a.jpg

GENERAL FIXES & CHANGES:

Using a Transport will no longer switch off your weapon (changing to barehands).
Fixed an issue with the group list health bars. 
Fixed a language pack issue on Battle Royale Airdrops.
Fixed a bug that was causing stamina desync with the server, causing crashes.
Fixed a UI issue that would cause the value of the discount on subscriptions not show properly.
Added Lobby MVP back to Battle Royale.
Fixed a minor issue in the Event Map server that would cause a bug that prevented accepting group invites in a very specific sequence of events.
Respawning to a Clan Territory will put that spawn on cooldown for 5 minutes.

OBJECTS AND ITEMS

Updated the Collision around the Airport in Colorado to avoid glitching through.
We have reverted the Airport Tower back to the original one. We found some issues with the updated version that was causing many texture bugs. 
Fixed the Adventure Backpack Desion Skin.
Fixed a material error on all M200 models.

notes.title: Patch 5.2
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/fb22fc5482054951b644aef86819ed6df9c2cc65.jpg
Hello everyone,
We are bringing another patch for you guys that will bring content for the next global event!
We are also making major corrections to the AI and Quality of Life towards them, along with engine corrections to improve overall performance for both game client and server. These will also allow us more leeway to create new features.
And we are adding a handy visual update to show you when you receive EXP and Season Pass XP. 

GENERAL CHANGES
GENERAL FIXES & CHANGES:

 Fixed a bug that would cause the AI's to not hit the zombies in the head in Survival. 
 Added the bandit camps to the minimap and the compass.
 Made improvements to the transport system (Bus, Clan Points, Safe Zone Shuttles) camera animation. 
 We have made it so the Season Pass XP is now moved to the world in 3D. When you kill a zombie, the text will fly off of it with how much XP you've received. 
 Fixed the Battle Royale and Competitive XP for playtime not being given. 
 Fixed a major bug when placing vehicles down. It will now head wherever you're heading. 
 Decreased the accuracy for Bandit AI's in close combat situations. 
 Increased the accuracy for AI's in Warm-up Servers when in long-distance situations.

notes.title: Patch 5.1
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
We are happy to announce a great new feature that is being worked on and is ready for an early release. We will be bringing AI to Infestation! 
This is something that's long overdue and is being asked by players for a couple of years now. 
Without further ado, here is the video of our DevBlog on the new AI Bots:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PYpK4v8KhS8

GENERAL CHANGES
GENERAL FIXES & CHANGES:
Added AI Bots to the game. For more details on it, watch the video above!
AI Bots have two main categories: Bandits and Civilians.
Bandits will shoot on sight and will drop loot.
Civilians will be semi-passive (only attack when are attacked). They will not drop loot. They can help players moving to and from safezones against other players and against zombies.

Disabled Clan Territories in PvE Servers
Updated Shadow Options
DeathMatch Gamemode Prototype has been added to the game. 
They will for now replace Warmup Servers and will have the new queue system similar to Competitive. Items are random and there is only 3 second revive time. More information on this coming soon.

Rifle Laser can be toggled on/off by pressing the Flashlight key (Default is F).
Fixed a major issue with sounds not playing properly when too many zombies were around you.
Fixed a bug with the Missions that would cause a crash when trying to complete them.
Improved the functionality of the flashlight and laser/flashlight attachments.

notes.title: Patch 5.0
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/944f99244ee74c6072d8ee69573351452b7962bd.png

GENERAL CHANGES
GENERAL FIXES & CHANGES:
Created an interactive Tutorial for Beginners. 
Though this might seem uninteresting for some players, after analyzing and collecting feedback from new players, we realized that this game is unique to a level that with no prior knowledge, it is easy to get lost on basic actions and objectives in the game. With that in mind, we created an interactive game tutorial made available for everyone to learn basic things and to help players get into the idea of the game in a more organized and logical way than just throwing them into a server with no instruction. 
Added more in-game tips
Updated the F1 Help screens.
Fixed a bug that would allow players to buy Premium even when they had Lifetime Premium.
Fixed an issue with the bus stop that would cause you to be stuck inside the structure after traveling. 
Added scrolling when you hover item names. 
You can now have up to five missions active in your HUD. The mission objectives on the right side are now collapsed. You can scroll between the missions by pressing a button (Default is ,(COMMA)). 
Fixed an issue that would cause all key bindings to be reset whenever we added a new key option.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/d4141931dfc33c4c48b4e285d21891d34ccdfd7c.jpg

ARCADE

Random Spawns have been fixed on Event Servers. 
Removed a few misplaced objects around and in the airport.


SURVIVAL

GENERAL CHANGES & FIXES
Fixed the zombie spawns around Trailer Park on Colorado V1. They wouldn't drop any loot ever. 


BATTLE ROYALE

GENERAL CHANGES & FIXES
Fixed a crash/freeze that was caused by a desync on Battle Royale. 
Leaving a Battle Royale match will incur an ELO penalization. 
Updated the new Safezone system to the Arena and Arizona maps which will bring them back to map rotation. 

EVENTS

We have added the content for two upcoming events:
The Medieval Event
Sete de Setembro (Brazilian Independence Day).

More information on those events coming soon...

notes.title: Patch 4.9
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/abcde4448bd6babe4d1b30c4a9ef646ff662031b.jpg

GENERAL CHANGES

GENERAL FIXES & CHANGES:
Clan invites now show you who invited you to the clan. 
Fixed a bug causing vehicles to not respawn. 
Added Trunk Storage to vehicles. They will have a similar system to the Personal Locker, but on wheels! Each vehicle has a different amount of slots and no weight restrictions. 
Fixed a bug that would allow players to shoot their Shotguns inside safezones (it still did no damage to other players). 
Fixed a bug that causes the player to get stuck on random objects forcing the player to jump.
Fixed a building with some windows you could walk through from the inside. 
Removed 4th of July Missions and Content.
Fixed an issue with the Airport Towers where you would be able to shoot through the walls. 
Zombie Damage from Flashlight has been increased.
Fixed the missing model from the Amphetamine vaccine.
M40A1 Remington 700 can now hold 5 bullets.


SERVER CHANNELS REWORK:
In order to better categorize and organize all our game modes with their subtypes (such as PVP, or Warmup in Arcade) we have restructured the internal layout. This will make future game mode or sub-game mode updates more reliable and faster to develop. Players should not notice any difference on how the server browsing works.
 
SURVIVAL

GENERAL CHANGES
Statistics previously not counted will now count towards the Top 1-10 Skins. 
When selecting Survival, you will not be prompted with the same screen as in Arcade, where you can choose which kind of servers you'd like to view. They will be limited to Official, Private and Premium Servers. 
Changed the weight of the Armor Plates from 3.0kg to 1.5kg. 
Added more collision walls around the Airport. 



BATTLE ROYALE

REWORK
We are doing some changes to the Battle Royale mode and its systems. 
Here are a few things we will be changing:
Battle Royale Server code has been rewritten
Note from the developer: The Battle Royale gamemode was created back in 2016, designed as a mini gamemode in mind. This made it extremely hard to work on, add features or fix bugs. It has now been recoded as a real gamemode, giving us more control over any of it's features and/or optimizations.
Reworked Radiation System: The Radiation system has been reworked in order to become more dynamic and smarter. It will start at a random area on the map, then will decrease within it. However, it will not be reduced exactly in the center. It will be randomly placed inside the new area. 
That will prevent players from being able to know exactly where the center will be when the match starts. 
Changed some UI elements and sounds: To reflect the changes with the radiation, the UI elements that display radiation on the minimaps and some sounds have been adjusted to match the new system.


GENERAL FIXES & CHANGES
Statistics previously not counted will now count towards the Top 1-10 Skins, including previous.
Fixed a bug playing the airdrop sound in Battle Royale when a airdrop is opened by a player.

MAPS
TROPICO (REWORK)
In addition to the major changes to the whole BR System, the Tropico map has gone through a rework as well. 
Loot and loot placement has been improved.
Made changes to the level design to make it easier to survive and protect yourself with hills and buildings.

COMPETITIVE

Warmup queue
Added a Warmup Server for players waiting for a competitive match. 
They work similar to the Battle Royale queue system.

notes.title: Patch 4.6
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/54380f0cac297272a8b04b17f64867af395c5239.png

GENERAL CHANGES

GENERAL FIXES & CHANGES:

Fixed a bug on the launcher that would cause it to freeze on loading when you pressed PLAY before the launcher was ready.
You can now invite/accept invites others while on death screen.
Added a Files Repair System on the standalone launcher.
Reorganized the Options Menu with links to the sub-sections.
Fixed a bug with the Unstuck Vehicle function that would cause vehicles to fly.
Fixed an issue with Physics on the parking lot.
Fixed an issue that would cause your car to be stuck on zombies when you tried running over them.
Fixed an issue that would cause a sound corruption when there were too many different sounds playing around you.
Improved the SSAO option. It now has a better quality but a lower performance impact. 
SSAO also improves the grass now.
Reloading a weapon will no longer desync when switching from First-Person to Third-Person or vice-versa.
Fixed a bug that would cause players to go under the ground when exiting a vehicle.





ITEM CHANGES

SHOTGUNS REWORK:

New types of ammo for shotguns have been added. The following are new types and their effects:[table][th]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/361cc8936519f98b6870a74cb572af096821ba56.png [/th]
[th]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/7289d1bbf9ee4ccc5cbcdb660fb4f8830799f1c0.png[/th]
[th]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/c4f69ba880e7fee588b2768a68a655e612dee58c.png[/th]
[th]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/7cf7c7892bf1b66fca58adacea6a4ea1c86691ba.png[/th][/table]

Flechette: Our current shells. Damage is slightly decreased. 
Slugs (MEDIUM-RARE): More range, less spread. 
Magnum (RARE): More damage, longer ranger and higher recoil. 

Shotguns will now only reload the ammo missing from the clip. Shotguns are now able to shoot mid-reload if there is more than 1 bullet.


ARCADE

FIXES & CHANGES

Fixed a problem on the parking lot building that is mainly placed in Caliwood.


MAPS
Colorado v2

Fixed the Clan Territory flag located in Glenwood Springs.
Added Collision Walls around some building roofs.
Fixed a player spawn at Glenwood Springs.


Caliwood

Fixed the LOD for some buildings, including the Hospital.
Fixed missing parts from buildings in their LOD.



SURVIVAL

FIXES & ADDITIONS

Re-balanced the loot on the L-Shaped buildings
Added item crates around the maps
Adjusted the LOD loading Distance for small tres


LOOT UPDATE
We are constantly working together with players to make the loot tables are as good as we can but we also should not forget, this is Survival and not an AR-Only Arcade mode.
Buffed military loot overall
Thirdend places will now spawn thirdend item types. For example Camp Splinter in Colorado has a higher chance of attachments.
Battery has been removed from the loot tables.


MAPS
Oregon

Fixed some terrain issues next to the prison.

Colorado

Removed some misplaced flying objects around Crystal Lake Resort.
Added more cover spots to the north of Clearview.

BATTLE ROYALE

FIXES & ADDITIONS

Damage from radiation is increased the longer you are in it.
New Skinbox for Battle Royale. Release will happen any time after the patch.

notes.title: [HOTFIX] Patch 4.4
notes.content:
Some issues may have occurred with the new skilltree system and this hotfix should address them all. 

OVERALL CHANGES

 Added a Reset button to the skill tree. You can reset your skills at any given time to redistribute it. 
 Lowered the overall amount of EXP required for a full skill tree.
 Don't worry, hardcore farmers/PVE, we will be adding more skills in the future focused solely on PVE.
 Added the missing levels to the Zombie Melee Damages.
 Increased the gain on the Stamina Skill Tree.
 Improved the loot from the Blue Medic Crates (both on Survival and Arcade).
 Damage done to the hand is lower than body damage now.
 Improved the XMR-32 Sniper and tweaked it. Since it's an extremely rare sniper, we feel it should be better than others.

 Lowered Sniper damage overall to better adapt to the new Skill Tree.
The sniper damage has been lowered to balance out with the new skill tree bonuses you get.

By lowering the damage of the snipers, sniper damage will now feel like it previously was.

notes.title: PATCH 4.4
notes.content:
https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26931738/082ffd0aaf56ad47b992cb84aab2e88f52925015.png

SUMMARY

 New Skill Tree System
 Physics improvements
 Netcode update
 Major performance improvement in servers
 Mission bugs fixed
 1vs1 Map added
 Classic Lounge is back
 Revive bug in BR fixed



GENERAL CHANGES

USER INTERFACES AND MENUS:

 Fixed some mistakes in the Spanish Localization
 Fixed some mistakes in the Russian Localization


GENERAL FIXES & CHANGES:

Skill Tree Rework

 We are releasing a new and more complete skill tree. This skill tree will require much more EXP but it will give you much more benefits. 
 Skills that have similar effects will have more levels and are grouped together, but you don't need to complete all level in order to progress. 
 There are some new skills that can be helpful as well. 
 To get a full skill tree you will need roughly 35 million EXP. However, to get the same skills as you currently have (as the previous full skill tree) you will need around the same. So choose where to place your skill points wisely. 
 All the skill points have been reset on all characters but your EXP is still there. 

OTHER CHANGES AND FIXES

 Fixed a bug that caused skinned items to have invalid/unused firemodes.
 Reworked the Weapon Restriction Option for Server owners. It's much simpler and more understandable.
 Optimized Zombies. Instead of lagging the whole game for you when loads of zombies die at once, the animation will be slowed down, that way the FPS will remain unaffected.
 Physics engine will now run at 60 fps, rather than 30. That means animations of server sided objects (grenades, zombies, items dropping) will be much smoother. 
 PhysX will now use more cores from your CPU (up to 4 instead of 2). This will be on higher end systems. This will improve overall performance when around many players/zombies/items.
 The grenade throwing system has been reworked for a smoother experience. 
 Updated the Netcode. Player movement should feel smoother now.
 Fixed a bug with some custom Riot Shields not having animation. 
 Fixed a major bug that caused servers with 50+ players to lag.
 Fixed a major bug with missions not loading correctly after a game updated.



ITEM CHANGES

ADDITIONS & CHANGES:

 Added Heavy Armor, K. Style and K. Style NVG skins for ranks 2-10. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/8f808b854f5ec717562897e972a568509e3be425.png


FIXES:

 Fixed the FPS model of the Gravestone Barricade
 Fixed the FPS perspective of the Riot Shields


ARCADE

FIXES & CHANGES

 Added Bleeding back
 Improved the Medic Drop inside the Medic Crates bottle


MAPS

 Added a new map called 1vs1 Arena

 Old Lounge Map is back
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/83cfe26118337600f8ed79ea4cb521b763ef874e.jpg



SURVIVAL

FIXES & CHANGES

 Fixed a UI bug with the crafting system


BATTLE ROYALE

 Fixed the revive bug in Battle Royale
 Reverted the spectator revive change. When revived, instead of disabling the spectator mode, it will spectate the player who's reviving you.
 Fixed a bug where you wouldn't receive a loss if you left a Battle Royale group.

Changed the VOIP system to a more reliable one. 				Fixed a bug with a dead body hit reg. 				Added FPS Cap option.				Added the option for server owners to add Winter Mode to their private servers.				Reworked the look of the Airdrop after it's been open. That way you will know if the Airdrop has been opened already.				Made more tweaks to weapons. Lowered overall Spread on them, but also lowered the reduction from attachments. That way they will feel the same way as they currently do with full attachments, but are improved overall with no attachments.				Buffed Karambit.				Nerfed Saiga.				Fixed some physics issues on the maps.				Added "Overgrowth" back to buildings in Survival.	
	Full Patch Notes:

	GENERAL CHANGES

	USER INTERFACES AND MENUS:
			Added a key-bind to drop the item currently selected from the in-game inventory. 				Added a new Tutorial image to explain the in-game HUD. You can access it by pressing on the icon  ?  or by pressing F1.				Fixed some localization in some languages.				Fixed a few UI bugs in Battle Royale.				Added a new Holiday song to the menu. You can toggle it on the Options Menu.				Menu music does not play if you are tabbed out of the game. 	
	GENERAL FIXES & CHANGES:
			Fixed several crashes both Server and Client-sided.				Added an FPS Cap option to the settings.				Changed the VOIP system from TeamSpeak to Vivox. 									Vivox is a much more reliable and modern system. For most of you, you won't feel much of a difference, but  disconnecting randomly from VOIP will be greatly decreased.									Double-clicking in the inventory will now use/equip/attach an item (you can disable that option from the Options Menu)				Added an option to add "Winter Mode" to your private servers.				Fixed a bug that caused the Slicer Icon to appear randomly on the map multiple times.				Fixed a bug related to dead body hit reg.				Fixed placing a shield on dead bodies.				Fixed an issue with eating food that could remove your shield.				Fixed an issue with Competitive Matches not starting in Oceania	
	ITEM CHANGES

	ADDITIONS & CHANGES:
			Reworked the Airdrop Icons.				Added a new model to show the Airdrop has already been open. That way you will be able to see if it's been open or not from afar.	
	{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/63ff3ee339f6657baa179496af53b33cf0962733.png
			Added a few new Airdrop types. More information soon.				Reworked the icon for a few items:									AR Barrel										Sniper Barrel										AR Stock										Sniper Stock										Snow Man Barricade									Changed the damage from the Karambit.									Player Damage: From 50 to 80.										Zombie Damage: From 80 to 105									Decreased the spread of guns globally. 									This means all weapons have had their spread reduced slightly so they can be used well without attachments. 									Decreased the spread reduction on all attachments.									This means at the end, with full attachments, you will have the guns as good as they currently are, but the difference from no attachments to full attachments will be lower. 									Decreased the damage and decay (distance to start having a reduction in damage) of the Saiga									Damage from 27 to 25.										Decay from 5 to 4.									Increased the damage of the grenade on Zombies.									From 140 to 160.									Changed the cooldown of the Wood Shields in Arcade back to what it was.	
	 

	SKINS & SKINBOXES:
			Fixed the Scope on the Hynx v2 OTS-SVU.				Fixed the material files for the M4 Apocalypse.	
	ARCADE

	GENERAL
			Loot:									Improved the respawn timer of the crates in the secret spots.						
	MAPS
			Colorado: 									Fixed a physics model at the airport where you were able to go through a wall.						
	SURVIVAL

	FIXES & CHANGES
			You can no longer deal damage to Group Members in Survival. Unfortunately, this was being heavily abused against new players. 	
	LOOT:
			Loot will continue being tweaked as we get general feedback. These changes do not require game patches to go live and we will keep you posted on those on the official Discord.

Added more vehicle spawns and increased the spawn chances.									COLORADO V1									Fixed the missing helicopter crash icon at Whitestone mountain.										Decreased the sound volume of the global ambient sound.										We are adding back the "Overgrowth" on buildings. This was something classic in I:SS and people voted to have it back. notes.title: Patch 4.0
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4326122/51c47625e9c9522bbfe17fcc7245384bb74abce3.jpg
	SUMMARY:
			Fixed the weapons system so macros cannot be abused. 				Reworked the OPTIONS menu for better understanding and navigation.				Bug fixes.				Improved the bus system on Survival for better navigation, without breaking the gameplay. 				Increased the amount of vehicle spawns on some maps.				Added new lootable crates. 				Increased the spawn protection timer on Survival.				Improved the spawns around the main PVP towns.				Made major changes to Wood Shield Barricades in Survival so they can be more common and not abused.				Improved the civilian and food loots in Survival.				Reworked the Safe zones in Oregon.				Weapon adjustments.	
	Full Patch Notes:

	GENERAL CHANGES

	USER INTERFACES AND MENUS:
			Fixed a bug that showed you the wrong "initial" character when selecting a game mode.				The weight system has been reworked and it should reflect better, and show better on the interface.				Added an option to show the distance from waypoints on the compass.				Split the GENERAL section of the OPTIONS menu. They're divided into General, Gameplay, and Interface.				Added an option to enable/disable profanity filter in chat. 				Fixed a bug that caused your screen to be stuck blurry when you get a notification your subscription is about to expire. 				Fixed some texts and localizations.	
	GENERAL FIXES & CHANGES:
			Fixed an issue in the UI on the Crafting Menu				Made some further changes to the guns and how they work to prevent people from abusing macros.				Fixed a bug that caused an error while joining your server through MY SERVERS that made you join with the wrong character.				You can no longer use the "ping system" when you're dead. 				Fixed a bug that made cars glitch out when someone jumped on them. 				Added a new progressive system to the "Map Events" (Heli crashes, airdrops, Slicer Zombies);									The more people there are on the server, the more frequent they will be.									Lowered the money you receive from Contested Areas.				Lowered the range of the zombie hits. 	
	 

	ITEM CHANGES

	ADDITIONS:
			Added 3 new item crates which will require new key cards. 	
	{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4326122/6b9ab1c46733b9d54de88f91b80c6e2e9f100037.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4326122/122ad8fe26f518265e12f29a2173803c030dc589.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4326122/e4d4951d63a0aa7ae260ef5547c75261e65e794e.png
	{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4326122/b95acc92be8b27c703758f6eb943da9b189544b7.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4326122/c8e3c37a20e4705b1d39b12ad7a98c79bdedc2a5.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4326122/39786e1bc0fcddd48aecc32af5bb933a2307b818.png
		The following weapons and attachments statistics have been changed:List too long - Detailed info can be found here https://playnewz.com/patch							Reworked the icons of the QBZ-95 and its skinned.	
	 

	SKINS & SKINBOXES:
			Changed the model of the Dreadnought Skinbox.				Fixed the drop model of the Competitive skin recipe.				Fixed all adventure backpack skins that didn't have skinned arm parts.	
	ARCADE

	MAPS
			Lounge:									Added a Winter themed Lounge									Colorado: 									Fixed the door at Lonetree farm that required a keycard to open wrongfully										Fixed some small map bugs such as flying objects, etc.									Oregon:									We have moved the previous Safe Zone to the Eastside added one further to the West.
				NOTE: Be careful when logging the first time if you had a character inside the safe zone before.						
	SURVIVAL

	FIXES & CHANGES

Replaced all the "Bus Stops" in the Safe zones with "Shuttles". 									You can now travel from safe zone to safe zone free of charge. 									Added some new bus stops across the map. notes.title: Patch 3.9
notes.content:
SUMMARY:
			Tweaked the Friends List, especially with the Steam friends list that could cause many minor issues. 				Made some changes to the Slicer zombie.				Fixed a lot of bugs related to zombies. 				Make some tweaks on weapons to balance them out better. 				Players will no longer respawn inside "events".				Made some adjustments to the zombie optimization systems.				Made some changes to the secret rooms so they can't be abused and you can't risk finding empty crates.				Made some tweaks to the contracts in Survival.				Adjusted spawns around Clearview and added cover.	
	Full Patch Notes:

	GENERAL CHANGES

	USER INTERFACES AND MENUS:
			Added more options for server owners on the Private Server panel.				Added a warning to the Flea Market in offers where weapons or ammo are not full. 				Tweaked the Friend system to avoid lags from huge friends lists. 				Fixed a UI bug in the Arcade Leaderboards that could cause a game crash.				Fixed a bug that causes the crafting screen to incorrectly show that the recipe required a workbench.				Fixed a bug that caused item descriptions to not show properly. 				Added an option to toggle Steam friends on/off.	
	GENERAL FIXES & CHANGES:
			The icon for the Airdrop will disappear after the Airdrop is looted.				Fixed a bug where the reviver time would go to 0 (visually) when you purchased something in the shop. 				The Slicer Zombie will no longer chase vehicles.				Fixed a bug that caused zombies not to be able to attack targets that were slightly higher than the zombies.				Players will no longer respawn inside Radiation areas. 				Fixed a kick that was caused due to sliding downhills. 				Fixed a bug that caused skinned items to not be counted as a crafting item resource. 				Made some changes to how the Secret Rooms work. From now on, you use the cards to open the crates rather than the door.				Heli Crashes will not instantly spawn zombies upon appearing on the map. 				You cannot use a gauze accidentally if you are not bleeding. 				Lowered interaction time on Lockers.				Adjusted the sounds of Zombie Dogs to make it easier to detect their direction.				Fixed a bug that caused the Slicer Zombie to respawn too quickly. 				Fixed a bug where other players' weapons would show incorrectly when aiming down.				Fixed a bug that caused zombies to glitch when dying and reappearing "frozen" in place. 				Fixed a bug on the server where they would lag for a second every 5 minutes and zombies would teleport around. 				Reworked zombie optimizations: 									To improve general performance a while back, we made some changes to the animation and their AI when they were far. We have fixed a few bugs related to this which will make them feel much smoother.									M4:									Spread has been slightly increased										Recoil has been slightly increased									AKM:									Spread has been slightly increased										Recoil has been slightly increased									FN Scar CQC:									Speed has been slightly decreased										Fire rate has been slightly decreased										Spread has been slightly decreased									FN Scar Nightstalker:									Fire rate has been slightly increased										Spread has been slightly decreased										Recoil has been slightly increased									AK-47:									Speed has been slightly increased										Spread has been slightly decreased									AN94:									Spread has been slightly increased						
	 

	ITEM CHANGES

	MODELS:
			Made some changes to the ladder models. This will prevent you from getting stuck on top.				Fixed a material issue on the Zombie Spike.	
	 

	SKINS:
			Fixes									Fixed the Light Sword Yellow. It was previously showing the wrong color. 						
	 

	SURVIVAL

	FIXES & CHANGES
			You will grant temporary immunity to the virus after using a Vaccine.	
	CRAFTING:
			Camping Backpack Recipe changes:									2x Hunter Backpacks are required now										Removed Nails									Added Gasoline Recipe:									3x Oil						
	CONTRACTS:
			Zombie Slayer II Contract									Decreased XP to 3500 (from 5000)									Zombie Slayer III Contract									Increased XP to 12000 (from 10000)									Alien Specialist Contract									Increased XP to 3500 (from 1500)									Helping Hand: C04 Vaccine Contract									Increased XP to 1000 (from 200)						
	MAPS:
			OREGON									Fixed some small map-related bugs										Added the missing resource spawns everywhere										Fixed a model issue at the Airport tower

notes.title: Infestation Patch Today 11/25/14
notes.content:
Hey survivors,
 
Servers will be going down at roughly 3 PM PST for.... PATCH TIME!!!  Here's the details!  
 
SERVERS
 
-Trial servers disabled (a trial can now only play on private servers where trials are enabled)
-New Hardcore Servers available
-Caliwood is moved off of the PTE for official release!
-Premium Caliwood Servers are now available
-The number of colorado servers has been reduced to make room for new Caliwood Servers
-Veteran servers reduced to a single Veteran Colorado and Veteran Caliwood
 
 
GAMEPLAY
 
-Crossbow has been buffed, now holds 5 arrows.
-A single arrow is now a bundle of up to 5 arrows.
 
COLORADO
 
-Airport fences have been slightly reworked to have more entrances to the airfield
-Fixed zombie pathing in some areas of the map that they were walking through objects
 
CALIWOOD
 
-Official release!
-Zombies have been removed from the center map construction yard in an attempt to bring down server load on Caliwood, loot remains in this location.  
-Various player respawn location fixes
 
STRONGHOLDS
 
-Dev Event Servers 1 & 2 have returned for casual fun PVP.  The loadout is pistols and crossbows. (NOT WORKING AT THE MOMENT. WILL HAVE A FIX BY TOMORROW)
 
HARDCORE SERVERS

notes.title: CALIWOOD UPDATE
notes.content:
Hey survivors!
 
Today we are having a patch for the Caliwood PTE (Public Test Environment) servers! Servers will be doing down at roughly 3 PM PST and we are expecting roughly 1 hour of maintenance.  
 
What is Caliwood?!
 
If you haven't heard about Caliwood then now is your chance!  Caliwood is a new map in the infestation world based loosely on Los Angeles.  Some areas of the Caliwood map may bare a striking resemblance :)  You can hunt regular zombies, super zombies, players and explore to your hearts content.  Ambient noises have also recently returned to the game. 
 
Here are the changes / additions / what to expect! 
 
CALIWOOD LOOT RULES:
 
There are no rules!  Bring items in, take items out, use the safe zone!  
 
-10 US PTE Caliwood servers
-10 EU PTE Caliwood servers
-5 RU PTE Caliwood servers
 
Lockers
 
-Place lock boxes anywhere AT YOUR OWN RISK.  These are STILL PTE (public test environment) servers and until they are OFFICIAL please use lockers on them at your own risk.  
 
Caliwood Official Release
 
-After a week of testing we expect Caliwood to officially release and move off of the PTE (public test environment).  For this next week PLEASE report any and all bugs on the forums!  
 
Patch Notes:
 
-Reminder that the revive timer has been removed, there is no wait or cost to ressurection!  
-Helmet popoff removed on all headware
-New Caliwood map located under the PTE server browser
-New car pile ups located randomly throughout the map with loot
-Most random vehicles have been removed from the map to increase performance
-Majority of the bridge section removed and turned into parks
-A family of Super Zombies is now living in the stadium
-Ambient sound scaping and scary noises have returned to the game!  Please report complaints / praise about the environmental sounds   :)
-Zombies running around dropping items and being menacing as usual
-Loot spawns around Caliwood city
-Loot spawns around San Pavel
-Loot spawns around West Oaks
-There is a safe zone located at the airport inside the hangar and also marked on the minimap
-No driveable vehicle spawns for the time being (perhaps after this first week of testing)
-You cannot rent a Caliwood server right now, they are only located in the PTE browser until we sort the kinks out.
-There are NO premium Caliwood servers for the time being 
-Cooldowns on medical supplies lessened by 2-3 seconds per item
-Crafted Poultice now heals for 40, up from 20
-Fixed boulder invisible collision
-Various player spawn fixes
-Fixed some floating spawns
-Fixed collision on walls at the airport
-Less sprinting zombies (they are pretty much extinct now)
-Spawned loot takes slightly longer to despawn
-Airport entrances returned
-Pistols, SMGs and ASRs have all been moderately buffed to be more effective
-Item boxes are mostly gone
-Original menu theme music is back

Main Site: http://forums.infestationmmo.com/index.php?/topic/155769-caliwood-patch-notes-111814/#entry1772565

notes.title: Caliwood Stress Test Today! Server Shutdown 2-3pm PDT
notes.content:
Welcome to Caliwood!
 
First and foremost, we urge players testing Caliwood to choose the highest population server available; by nearing or meeting a server's capacity, OP can best gauge performance and identify further opportunities for optimization. Thank you in advance for helping us collect this data as quickly as possible.
 
Game servers will be going down around 2pm PDT to put Caliwood into the PTE Servers. During this time, the forums will still be available for open discussion about the new iteration of California. 
 
Please direct your feedback and error reporting to the discussion thread found HERE. 
 
Important Items to Note:
 
- No Vehicles will be on the map
- Zombies have been added 
- Zombies will drop various types of loot (guns\armor\attachments\consumables\etc.)
- Loot can be taken out of the map but there will be no safe zones or NPCs to bank
- 5 Caliwood servers will be available on US\EU
- 1 Caliwood server will be available on RU 
- Each server will have a 200 player limit
- EXP and Reputation will be carried over from this map just like any other

Additional Notes:
 
-There is NO LOOT SPAWNING on the map for this iteration of the test, however loot is DROPPING off of zombies
- Disconnect issue with repair kit has been fixed
- Added Emergency Brake (Default Left Shift Key) to vehicle functionality
- Safe zone and vault NPC from Cliffside has been removed
 
We are very excited for you all to experience Caliwood with the latest changes. Remember, direct all your feedback to the discussion thread linked in the beginning of this post. All your input and testing is critical to the map's official release. 

Hope you enjoy and thank you for your ongoing support and patience!
 
Infestation Team

notes.title: UPDATE: Caliwood Stress Test:
notes.content:
Hey everyone, 

As you know, OP Productions launched the California map for testing several months ago, which recently concluded. California has been a huge challenge that we undertook with the desire to realize a much larger map with ample space for both players and zombies to roam the countryside in large, fun-seeking packs.

We’ve continued working to improve California so we can deliver a finished map that can be played and enjoyed by everyone. As we've analyzed the data collected from the test server over the past months we have arrived at several conclusions. While it’s important to shoot for the moon, the reality of our resources and the technical limitations of optimizing such a large map have led us down another path. As a result, California has been truncated to focus on Caliwood and a few of the surrounding towns.

While the new map is similar in size to Colorado, fewer impassible areas result in an overall gain in playable square kilometers. We are proud of the map as it now stands; a vibrant travel destination, the Caliwood area sports a variety of tourist destinations and a night skyline that contrasts the lonely savagery of the Colorado wilderness.  Additionally, we are happy to report that the life-challenged denizens of the area will be more lively and able to range more freely throughout the map. Their population is also on the rise... We hope you bring your jogging shoes and your SPF50!

In the coming weeks, we'll relaunch the updated map for an intensive, limited-time stress test. The results will enable us to quickly formulate a rollout plan for the new map and identify any final adjustments needed to polish the experience. From all of us at OP Productions, thank you again for your patience. We're really excited and looking forward to your participation!

Discussion about this can be found here - http://forums.infestationmmo.com/index.php?/topic/153078-california-stress-test-discussion/

notes.title: January 15 2014 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Greetings Survivors!

We have some exciting changes to bring forth to you in the latest update. Various vehicle updates as well as the return of Global Inventory stacking.

Check out the changes below to see exactly what's being released!

Patch Updates:
Updates will be every other week. This means the missions will stay for two weeks before new missions become available. This also gives us more time to find issues with content before we release it to the public.

Vehicle Changes:
- Fixed a server crash associated with vehicles
- Fixed issue with entering a vehicle while in ADS\scope\binoculars
- Fixed frequent crash associated with hitting another player while in a vehicle
- Fixed crash that happened when players died in a vehicle as it exploded and despawned
- Added ability to change vehicle controls in options menu
- Added ability to unstick vehicles using F5
- Removed ability to cause Infection and Bleeding on players that are in vehicles
- Vehicles take less damage from environmental hits\interactions such as jumps\crashes.
- Improved functionality associated with exiting a vehicle in odd\strange positions and slopes
- Improved damage model for vehicles:
Shooting the tires no longer inflicts damage on players
Players must aim for the windshield in order to do damage to others in the vehicle
Players will start to take damage after a % of damage has been inflicted on the vehicle
- Fixed some sound issues associated with vehicles
- Decreased likelihood of zombie bodies becoming distorted when hit.

California Map Changes:
- Fixed crash with Night Vision while on California test map.

Colorado Map Changes:
- Removed five story building in Clearview and added environmental objects
- Removed all Holiday related content
- Fixed floating fences in Campos City
- Deleted barbed wire fence in Norad
- Super Zombies are now being spotted in the following locations: Ridgeway airport, Norad, Glenwood Springs, Boulder City and the blocked off area North of Blue Ridge
***Updated: Super Zombie will still take melee damage but will continue to attack if you are in striking range. Originally this was the fix for all zombies to be able to reach and attack you even if standing on a box. This trait was only given to Super Zombie instead.
- Super Zombie now gives 250 XP for killing him along with loot.  (respawn is 7200 seconds aka 2 hours)
- Super Zombie has super reach to make him less perchable
- Added trees for cover in forests behind Clearview
- Lowered zombie population in Clearview

Stronghold Map Changes:
- Fixed an issue with farms not working properly
- Fixed missing collision on giant cinder-block north of the town on Cliffside
- Lowered required resources to build both Small and Large Generators
- Added three repair benches
- Added Safe Zone\Global Inventory access
- Premium Harvesting Tool upgraded to give the user 500 swings
- Harvesting Tool upgraded to give the user 250 swings
- Fixed an issue with resource gathering reporting only 1 gathered and not 2.
- Resources can now be gathered on all maps

Veteran Servers:
Description updated to reflect 300 HR requirement

Gameplay Changes:
- Can no longer stand on heads of players. Characters will slide off when attempted.
- When a weapon reaches zero durability it will be destroyed and all ammunition along with it
- Durability meter added to the UI for guns
- Allowing weapon stacking Global Inventory
- ***Update: Can now access Marketplace anywhere by pressing F10 (default key) -  (Note that you are vulnerable to attack while in this menu. Spend too long window shopping and you will be killed)
- Fall damage disabled in Safe Settlements
- Renamed item: Artemis Knives Hat
- Harvesting Metal is now done by taking the Harvesting Tool to burned out vehicles for scrap metal.
- New missions that will be available are:
   Kill the Super Zombie
   Serial Killer: Machine Gun
   Mission for Love
   Helping Hand: Medkit
   Helping Hand: C04 Vaccine

notes.title: Patch Notes: December 18, 2013: Cali, Super Zombies and Strongholds!
notes.content:
Server Downtime: 3:00 PM Estimated downtime: 3 hours 
 
California Stress Test: We are asking that you join us in our stress test for California.
 
How it will work: We will need as many people as possible to join the first PTE California server in the server listing. Our goal is to fill it to capacity and we ask that users just do what they would normally do, aside from killing zombies. Drive cars, trade, shoot, jump, whatever your little heart desires. Just get in and play!!!!
 
Come join the discussion and live stress test on http://www.twitch.tv/artemisknives and stay tuned in for Strongholds with ArtemisKnives as well!  
 
So many great things have been happening to the zombie filled lands of Infestation. Within the last month you have been introduced to content left and right! 
 
This patch is no different! We are opening up our test servers for California and for Strongholds. These two features are in their respective testing phases so please make note of any and all issues associated with each one and report them in the appropriate topic in the Bugs section. 
 
Stronghold Issues:
http://forums.infest...st-bug-reports/
 
California Map Issues:
http://forums.infest...ap-bug-reports/
 
Super Zombie Issues:
http://forums.infest...ie-bug-reports/
 
Strongholds
Players will spawn with just a backpack and empty inventory.  No items can be brought in or of Stronghold Maps.
There will be absolutely NO GI Access.  
Water, food and standard harvesting tools will be spawning during the Stronghold testing phase.
2x market place vendors located on the map at the tunnel and at the end of the road outside town for player convenience.
In game we will spawn pickaxes that, when equipped, will highlight objects that can be mined. Left clicking next to such object will mine it for resources. Those resources can be used to craft new stronghold items (walls, lights etc)

California Pre-Alpha Stress PTE
We are allowing GI Access
We are allowing players to bring items to the map and take items off the map.
There is a building located at the edge of the military airport which will be considered to be a safe zone. An NPC will be located in the middle hangar and provide GI access.
We have littered the map with vehicles to move about the city a little faster. That is of course, if another survivor doesn't jack you for your ride!
Food and water will be spawning throughout the city.
There will not be any zombies on the map. 

Zombies\AI: Colorado V2 PTE Server ONLY
Super Zombies: These monstrosities are said to inhabit the Ridgeway Airport. Locals always knew there was something odd about those crates that were being delivered to the military base! Who will be one of the firsts to take one out?  

Missions:
Updated Missions: New available missions - All in progress or unfinished missions will be removed. 

Vehicles:
Vehicle modifications - skidding sounds.
Removed ability to damage player in safe zone
Fixed Vehicles running into Barricades causing client crash
Added new vehicle UI to the in-game HUD
Fixed some disconnect issues.
Improved running over zombies/players.
Added damage to vehicles from grenades.
Right Click on the mouse enables Rear View Camera
Striker HP now 6000 down from 10000
Truck HP now 2000 down from 4000
Buggy HP now 1800 down from 3500
Fixes added for possible desynchronization of active physics when another player enters a vehicle and takes control while its still rolling.

Art\Graphical:
Added graphical option to disable shadows when using custom settings. 
V2 lighting has been changed. There is a broader spectrum of color on V2 compared to it's original screenshots and the night has gotten a bit darker as well. 
Adding lights to Christmas tree in Boulder City

Misc. Fixes
Fixed audio issue with vehicle sounds
Fixed trade issues when entering a vehicle

notes.title: November 19, 2013 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello Survivors!
 
Here are the patch notes for Tuesday, November 19th.
 
The patch is scheduled for ~4:30PM PST. The estimated downtime is one hour.
 
 Missions have been added
 Complete various activities for in-game rewards
 More details can be found here: http://forums.infest...ons-mini-f-a-q/
 Clan Reserve GC has been removed
 All GC left in the Clan Reserve is being moved to the Clan Leader’s account
 GC can no longer be transferred between accounts
 Private Server Rental has changed
 Anyone is now able to extend the rental hours of a Private Server
 A Donate GC button has been added to the Private Server browser list so players can add time to the private server without paying for an entire month or week at a time. 
 1 Week button has been added to the Private Server Rental Period options
 Gun Recoil has changed
 Guns no longer recenter after being fired when standing: This effect is reduced when crouching and removed when prone
 Recoil has been reduced for Assault Rifles, SMGs, Shotguns, and Pistols
 Recoil has been increased for Sniper Rifles
 The Global Inventory has changed
       The number of slots has been reduced to 200 total available slots. You   will keep all of your weapons. If you have more than 200 slots you will not be able to use your GI until you get under 200.
       Guns, melee weapons, armor and weapon attachments will no longer be stackable in the global inventory.
Beginning November 27th, the InfestationMMO servers will undergo routine maintenance
This will be performed every Wednesday at 3PM PST
Maintenance is expected to last less that 30 minutes

Bug Fixes
Barricades are now placed at the correct location
Dropped items now immediately appear on the floor
Moving while prone now produces noise
Prone and crouch can no longer be used at the same time
Flare particles now follow the flare instead of always going up
Characters can no longer become stuck in the jumping pose
Fixed an issue that was causing server crashes
Updated the navigation library for zombies
Craft menu no longer displayed if the hotkey is pressed while in chat or an in-game menu
FPS has been improved in various locations across Colorado V2
Hidden Forest Ranch has now been added to the in-game map for reference
V2 Campos five story now accessible. Confirmed. 
Food, drinks, and melee spawns have increased in both V1 and V2. 
Fixed an issue that allowed items to drop into the world and other objects. 
Fixed a crash when switching to French language 
Fixed an issue with Crafting supplies not spawning on V1
